propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate set the direction for the deployment service and settled the backlog order each sprint with platform engineering and consuming teams.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the roadmap ownership directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran release reviews for eight deployment-service releases and recorded decisions in the release record.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the release record document the reviews.

propositions.canonicalProposition: Deployments completed without manual intervention rose from 62 percent to 84 percent in the three months after the automated rollback release, against a documented baseline of 62 percent.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the figures, period, baseline and report; the work sample and reference confirm them.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each release are only partly documented in the release notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the intervention result as stated for the three months after the rollback release; do not extend it to other services.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded for each release.
